name: ncbi_gtf
description: GTF annotation as distributed by NCBI, stored verbatim. Named for its actual source so the vault does not claim a provenance it does not have: refgenie ships no NCBI GTF recipe, and filing an NCBI annotation under gencode_gtf would assert a GENCODE origin it does not have. A passthrough - no derived TSS or gene-body BEDs, since those transformations in ensembl_gtf assume Ensembl contig naming and attribute ordering.

required_files.description: Annotation file in Gene Transfer Format (GTF) from NCBI
